name: Native Sparse Attention · NSA
tagline: Combine compressed, selected and local attention.
description: Learned compression, selected attention and sliding-window attention run in parallel and merge through gates. Compression and selection both use 32-token blocks in this explicitly defined native adaptation.
paperTitle: Native Sparse Attention: Hardware-Aligned and Natively Trainable Sparse Attention
mechanism: Three attention branches: compression, selection and local context, each with a sigmoid gate
Non-overlapping compression and selection blocks of 32 tokens
A 256-token historical selection budget, plus the current tail and a local window of 512
limitations: This configuration does not cover arbitrary overlapping compression or unequal block sizes. All three branches must be included in the compute ledger.
